# MEL ONE | Canberra Waterproofing

> English-language official website for MEL ONE waterproofing and leak repair enquiries in Canberra, ACT.

## Contact
- Phone: 0482 422 607
- Email: riley@melonemaintenance.com.au
- Address: 121 Marcus Clarke St, Canberra ACT 2600

## Scope
Bathrooms, leaking showers, resealing and regrouting, balconies, kitchens, laundry waterproofing, external water ingress and roof-leak enquiries. Scope, availability and appropriate trade coordination are confirmed for each property.

This content index summarises the visible MEL ONE website. It does not replace the visible pages, robots.txt or sitemap.
